title: Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, made with tender beef and a hint of zesty spices.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: your favorite store-bought or homemade stew mix

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes in batches, about 5 minutes per batch.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew mix, tomato paste, and beef broth to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot and add the red wine (if using).
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-3 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and zesty spices to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
